items.text: Reserve critical actuator supply before releasing the balance
Aggregate headroom hides a concentrated 16-week lead-time constraint. Do not treat unconfirmed supplier allocation as available capacity.
The Q4 capacity plan covers baseline demand, but a long-lead actuator constraint leaves the launch buffer exposed.
Northstar launch · weeks 38–45 · supplier feed closed 2026-09-23 18:00 UTC · demand scenario P70 · allocation review for Operations and Procurement.

Confirmed capacity exceeds the P70 baseline by 2.7% in aggregate. Another 27,500 actuator units remain unconfirmed across two suppliers; the 116-day lead time makes that small buffer fragile. Do not treat planned capacity as firm supply until the dated allocation lands.
Next step: reserve 18,000 qualified actuators now, then release the remaining build only after supplier NC-8841 confirms its dated allocation.
